from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """A single cash flow line item from the financing activities section of a 10-Q."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to, as named in the document")
    line_item: str = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Advances on credit lines', 'Commercial paper issued')")
    amount: str = Field(description="The amount as written in the document, preserving format (e.g. '$44.4 million', '$30.9 million')")
    inflow_or_outflow: str = Field(description="Whether this line item represents cash inflow or outflow")
    period_end: str = Field(description="The period end date for this filing (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[FinancingCashFlow]
